title: UI风格#118 - Tokyo Pop (东京波普)
description: 创建第118种UI风格：东京波普风格 - 日本漫画、霓虹色彩、超大字体。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDN.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop style When color palette Then features manga black, bubblegum pink, electric yellow, cyan pop
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#000000 (漫画黑), #FF69B4 (泡泡糖粉), #FFE135 (电气黄), #00D4FF (青色流行), #FF1493 (洋红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop style When typography Then uses manga fonts: Bangers, Russo One, orPermanent Marker
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Bangers (粗体标题), Russo One (正文), Permanent Marker (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop style When layout Then speech bubbles, action lines, manga panels, speed effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：对话框、速度线、漫画分镜、动作效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop style When UI elements Then speed lines, impact frames, pop art colors, halftone dots
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：速度线、冲击框、波普艺术色彩、半调点

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop UI When functional Then includes manga chat, anime agents, power stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：漫画聊天、动漫代理、能力统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Tokyo Pop UI When copy Then uses manga: 'KAKU', 'SAIKYO', 'BAKURETSU', 'POW'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'BAKURETSU! KAKU SAIKYO!'、按钮'SEND'→'POW!'、'SUBMIT'→'BAM!'
